tuition_waiver: Full or partial exemption from payment of academic tuition fees granted to SC, ST, PwD, and economically backward students.
seat_matrix: Sanctioned intake capacity broken down across reservation categories (Open, EWS, OBC-NCL, SC, ST, PwD).
composite_score: Weighted score used for MBA admission shortlisting incorporating CAT percentile, work experience, and gender diversity.
rka: Registration Kept Alive, an academic status allowing postgraduate scholars to maintain enrollment during thesis finalization.
